threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'the tube' instead of just saying 'the train' like everyone else does around here.
Last week on the N37, a guy tried to sell his mixtape. Not sure if it was bravado or just the cold, but he performed a whole track without a microphone!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I heard a spontaneous jam session outside my window, mixing Turkish folk with techno beats. Neukölln in a nutshell.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find a packed club where people dance surrounded by cages filled with live chickens. It’s as bizarre as it sounds.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by their effortless dodging of the BART delays; tourists just stand there, eyes wide, confused by the frenzy.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a glimpse of a whole marching band stuck at Civic Center, waiting for the Muni to clear. Only in SF do musicians become part of the transit chaos.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all bars in Gràcia close at midnight, but locals know the best ones keep it going until 2 or 3, especially on weekends.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by the way they still think they can catch a train during a Rodalies strike, frantically checking their phones for updates.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still walk into the supermarket thinking you have to pay for bags—everyone else just brings their own.
Caught a night bus from Brixton, a couple arguing over a missing shoe; turns out it was at the back seat the whole time, classic London chaos.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I stumbled upon a spontaneous street concert outside my window, with neighbors dancing like it was an everyday affair.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you find spontaneous dance parties in U-Bahn stations when the trains break down. It's chaos, but the city's rhythm thrives in the unpredictability.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know a local when they calmly step over the dog on the tracks at Civic Center instead of freaking out like a newbie. That's just another Tuesday here.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Just saw a guy in a tuxedo chasing a bus from the Civic Center, tripping over a dog on the tracks. Classic SF chaos.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think ‘Gràcia’ is just a cute neighborhood, but they miss the locals' secret of vibrant plazas coming alive with spontaneous concerts on weekends.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their curious look at the plaça's pigeons—like they've never seen the locals argue over bread crumbs before.
